parameters.content:
## LangGraph Autonomous AI Agent Gateway (Native OpenAI Chat Model Selector)
- **Pick Brain Model**: Click **`Brain LLM (OpenAI Chat Model)`** -> choose any n8n OpenAI-compatible credential (River AI, OpenAI, OpenRouter, Groq, Gemini, Ollama) -> pick any model from the live dropdown.
- **Pick Sub-Agent Model**: Click **`Sub-Agent LLM (OpenAI Chat Model)`** -> choose any credential & model independently for isolated LangGraph sub-agents.
- **Swap Provider Nodes**: You can even swap either node for any other n8n Chat Model node.
- **Strict Separation**: n8n only reads the selected model & credential settings; all reasoning, tools, checkpoints, and HITL approvals run in Python LangGraph.

parameters.agentDescription: Gateway forwarding tasks to the Python LangGraph Autonomous AI Agent using models selected in the native n8n OpenAI Chat Model nodes.
parameters.initialMessages: Connected to the Python LangGraph Autonomous AI Agent Gateway. Select Brain & Sub-Agent models using the two OpenAI Chat Model nodes in n8n (or override per message with `/brain provider:model` and `/subagent provider:model`).
